init_imagebind_model: initialize an ImageBind model with optional checkpoint path and device for audio-video embedding extraction
compute_audio_video_similarity: compute cosine similarity scores between audio waveforms and video tensors using the ImageBind model
load_custom_checkpoint: load a custom ImageBind checkpoint instead of the pretrained model weights
normalize_embeddings: L2 normalize audio and video embeddings before computing similarity scores
review_ImageBind_call: review the ImageBind __call__ method to understand audio-video scoring with batched candidates
